content:
Amara connects the team with local hosts and storytellers. Her reminder that
“a map is an invitation, not an inventory” shaped
[Design principles](/note/notes/design_principles) and the
[Mobile Story Booth](/note/projects/mobile_story_booth/mobile_story_booth).

occurrences.context: - People: Alex, Amara, and the full People section - Projects: active, planned, completed, and idea - Tasks: todo, in progress, blocked, and done records with subtasks and deadlines - Calendar: social and work events, a weekly series, project links, and a cross-midnight event
Community hosts Sofia Rossi and Amara Okafor keep the work grounded in real conversations.

- [ ] Print a one-page version of the sharing levels - [ ] Turn three field observations into anonymous discussion cards - [ ] Reserve a quiet table and visible exit route - [ ] Confirm the facilitation plan with Amara - [ ] Add the outcome to the event note
